notes.title: September 15th Patch
notes.content:
In Pedro Land DX, the little tutorial clouds present in a couple of the modes have been removed, since they don't match the new controls.
In Pedro Lost Tales, some text for letting players know about the museum lock has been fixed.
In the Pedro Deep Delve mode, I had forgotten that the treasure that I thought was missing was actually in some crates in one of the rooms. That has been fixed. The treasure's current hiding place is in one of the earlier rooms.

I hope you all will still enjoy this game.
 - Jared, main developer of Pedro Land DX and Pedro Lost Tales

notes.title: September 1st Patch
notes.content:
Another fix for the Pedro Lost Tales expansion.
Pedro 4 Seasons Final boss' collision mask has been fixed.
Pedroverse: One level had a boss appear where he wasn't supposed to be there.
Pedro Deep Delve: A treasure that was missing has been added to one of the rooms.
A secret cutscene was also added for those who will find every treasure!

notes.title: August 28th Patch
notes.content:
Fixed some more issues with the Pedro & Sir Boil player swap mechanic.
Some bosses and enemies in that mode are also tweaked.

notes.title: August 25th Patch
notes.content:
Fixed a forgotten ladder placement in the Pedro Lost Levels boss rush.
Fixed the player swap mechanic for the Pedro & Sir Boil mode.

notes.title: August 23rd Patch
notes.content: In Pedro Lost Levels, some areas had impossible ladder jumps. Those have been fixed.

notes.title: August 22nd Patch - NEW FREE EXPANSION: Pedro Lost Tales (This is also a test)
notes.content:
Let's get some stuff out of the way first...
In Pedro Land DX, when playing using a keyboard, Jump has been mapped to "K", and Shoot has been mapped to "J", to be consistent with how most platformers use those keys.

Now onto the bigger stuff...
We have decided to add in a game that was meant to be a sequel to Pedro Land DX, Pedro Lost Tales.
This free expansion has several new campaigns to conquer!

I have never tacked one game onto another before, so if there are bugs or game-crashing glitches, I will seek to (hopefully) fix them post-launch.
We hope this new expansion will make you players smile. :)

- Jared, main developer of Pedro Land DX and Pedro Lost Tales

notes.title: Jan. 11th Patch
notes.content:
Fixed a level error.
Fixed one boss's player detection code.

notes.title: Jan. 10th Patch
notes.content:
Fixed a boss not detecting the player.
Fixed a secret not having a proper hint.

notes.title: Dec. 20 Patch
notes.content: Fixed some player detection glitches for a few bosses.

notes.title: September Recent Bug Fixes
notes.content:
In some recent updates I didn't specify what bugs were fixed, so here's the rundown:

Fixed some npc and player interactions.
Fixed a missing collision with an enemy for Pedro.
Fixed an issue where there was no player in  a Pedro Land 2 level.

I apologize for these small issues. 
I hope ya'll continue to enjoy the game!
-Jared

notes.title: July 26 Patch
notes.content: The tracks used in Level 1 and level 2 in Taco Tower have been improved to match the original compositions found in the soundtrack swapper. The previous versions are available to listen to through the secret Leftovers soundlist hidden in the options menu.

notes.title: July 18 Patch
notes.content: Fixed some issues with players not being detected by enemies, text objects, etc.

notes.title: 4th of July Patch
notes.content:
Happy 4th of July!

Noticed a small game crash with a specific hazard in the Pedro Land 3 mode.
That bug has now been squashed.

notes.title: Pedro Land DX Patch Update: 2nd Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
It's already been TWO years since Pedro Land DX dropped on Steam!

Here's what this update includes:

Added an on/off toggle for music and sfx in the options menu.
Fixed some player collisions with walls and semisolid surfaces.
Added completion icons that show up when the player beats a mode with Pedro's knight form, Miguel, Rush, and Shamel.
Some other minor fixes with sounds, text, and other things.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Pedro Land DX: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Pedro Land DX has been out for over a year now, but I though the game needed a little more spice, so I made some fixes to the game's inner workings, as well as some extra things.
Pedro and friends have been given a visual update again, to closer resemble artwork, but may also lead to more expressions.
The playable characters' run physics have also been updated. Now you can skid across the floor like an old-school platformer mascot!
In the options you can now use the SOUNDTRACK SWAPPER! With this new feature, you can hear some older, unused versions of the Pedro Land and Pedro Land 2 soundtracks.
I hope you all have enjoyed Pedro Land DX, and Merry Christmas!

-Jared, creator of Pedro Land DX

notes.title: Final Fiesta: A Picture to the Past
notes.content:
Steam screenshots have now been enabled. Pressing F12 now lets you take screenshots!

Added a secret enemy and boss museum. 
The option is hidden somewhere on the Pedro Land DX menu screen.

notes.title: Final Fiesta: A Fiery Addition
notes.content:
Added a new power-up: the Fire Pepper!

Collect this to increase your movement speed. You can also shoot fireballs instead of normal bullets!

notes.title: Final Fiesta: The After Party...?
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where jumping through a semisolid platform will freeze the game.
Added a secret mode labeled "Mancabra".
Added the Holy Gun as a secret power-up.

notes.title: Final Fiesta: The Leftovers
notes.content:
Pedro's Jump height varies depending on how long you hold down the jump button/key.

Added hidden Sound Test menus. These can be accessed from the same hidden menus that hold the Boss Rush options.

Added a secret Leftovers Sound Test that holds unused Pedro Land tracks.

notes.title: Final Fiesta Update!
notes.content:
Added extra story content & Steam Achievements!
Added Pedro Land 2.
Added Pedro Land 3.
Added Wicked Tower.
Soundtrack was changed to resemble old NES chiptune.

notes.title: SPICY SALSA UPDATE
notes.content:
Pedro Land DX is going out with a bang in the new Spicy Salsa update!
Things Added:
Controller compatibility,
Fullscreen switching,
New Spicy Levels: a new world with some hard as nails levels,
and some smaller gameplay changes.
